evidence.detail: Game SQLAlchemy model has columns: id, match_id, winner_id, log — no inactivity flag column exists
import_log() iterates game lines and checks regexes for game header, switcheroo, gatherling events — no check for 'lost the game due to inactivity' text
__create_schema() uses create_all() which creates missing tables but does NOT add columns to existing tables — any new column requires an ALTER TABLE

triage.notes: Implementation requires: (1) ALTER TABLE game ADD COLUMN had_inactivity BOOLEAN, (2) detection in importing.py for the regex '@P lost the game due to inactivity', (3) display in logsite views/templates. Schema migration is the blocker.
